references.title: GTA Guide · Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.description: Obtain every other trophy and become a Leonida Legend.
trophies.guide: Collect all 54 other trophies, including the 100% completion reward. The source gives no numeric Gamerscore value for the Mythic equivalent.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening chapter and finish Gone Fishing. The source describes this early reward as unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Continue the story into Chapter 2 and complete What's in the Bag?; that is the reported trigger.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the chapter and play Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3. The title is masked in the source list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: After the chapter, complete Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4; the notes place the unlock after both.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Follow the main story through the fourth chapter. No extra performance condition is noted.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the finale. Free roam remains available after the credits for unfinished activities.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Find Breakfast Run during Chapter 2 and complete its objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Progress to The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and finish the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play during Chapter 4.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4 and complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. The separate jet departure activity is not this mission reward.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Advance to the Chapter 5 operation and complete its objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, check Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Targets include all 8 vaults, 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, 42 range golds, 42 drone races and Bret's 15 hunts. Other categories require partial totals, including 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts and 200 vehicle scans. Earlier progress counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Jumps, bridge flights, knife-edge flights and base jumps all contribute. The source suggests bridge flights as a quick route; 100% requires 300 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each of the nine activity types.
trophies.guide: Fish, hunt, play golf, visit a range, play pool, make a basketball shot, finish an arcade game, win a race and perform a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn gold in every shooting-range challenge.
trophies.guide: Win 42 gold medals across the 12 ranges. Range visits also improve Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun drone race at each location.
trophies.guide: Win once at each of the 14 locations. The full completion target is all 42 races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Choose from the 40 races and win 20 distinct events. Repeating the same race does not add to the total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Win a fishing challenge against Cal.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in Feng Shui, follow his text to a fishing spot, then complete his quest line and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one of the games on the home TV or play Bang For Your Buck on an arcade cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.guide: As Lucia, take Andy's Chapter 3 text and complete his five jobs: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.guide: Recover treasures from seven shipwrecks at purple markers. Dive and use the metal detector; look for Kenton's later follow-up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, take Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. Hometown Heroes is the last.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.guide: The notes list Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as examples that count. Follow the trophy counter; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are listed as non-qualifying.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK to identify the 16 requested sports cars, then deliver them to Randy's garage in western Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.guide: As Jason, start the jobs after Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synthetic labs and finish Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot until the counter reaches 18.
trophies.guide: Accept Lucia's balcony invitation the morning after Down to Earth. Visit other meditation spots; a joint session counts twice. The source says the early session may be missable, but does not confirm it is required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start Bret's hunting jobs after Coffee Break. The source does not identify the required animal; all 15 jobs count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Track progress in Progress → Collections. Complete any three sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Record qualifying landmarks, oddities, sculptures or No Flusher graffiti until the counter reaches 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% target is 70.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Escape a four-star wanted level with your partner.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner, reach four stars and escape beyond the red zone. A vault robbery can provide the wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob three stores in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level.
trophies.guide: Try the three northern Vice City jewelry stores in sequence. The notification may be delayed by about 30 seconds.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan distinct models passing on busy roads; there is no need to steal them. The 100% target is 200 models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Kill five enemies during one Combat Focus activation.
trophies.guide: Fill Focus first and bring an assault rifle. Activate Combat Focus near a group of enemies and defeat five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Perform an unplanned takeoff from VCIA.
trophies.guide: Take a large passenger jet from a gate's jet bridge, take off and travel roughly one kilometre from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Kill enemies from a stolen tank.
trophies.guide: Look for tanks along the southern edge of Mile Zero Air Station on Mariana County's southwestern island. Take one and use it against enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Chapter 3 missions provide the Snap Gun. Use it at the rear door and locate the safe-code note in the storeroom.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.description: Rob five bank vaults and escape.
trophies.guide: Unlock vaults through That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4. Escape from five; all eight are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and get away.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The source also notes that escaping after a bank-vault robbery can count.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the full map. The source recommends flying over unexplored regions to clear fog quickly.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation belonging to every gang.
trophies.guide: Complete at least one operation from each of the nine gangs. The full completion target includes all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view of Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The supplied condition is a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach. The specific steps remain unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's display window.
trophies.guide: The notes give the objective but do not identify a particular showroom or detailed setup.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Rob a Port Gellhorn bowling alley and escape police.
trophies.guide: The guide names Kingpin Bowling and lists a watch, a Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and a safe among the valuables.
trophies.caveat: The official description cited in the notes instead names Kolt & Associates; this venue-name conflict is unresolved.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.description: Max out Strength for both characters.
trophies.guide: Train at fitness clubs with your partner. The notes say training one character also boosts the other.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Complete 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide: Profile-changing actions add up during play. The source warns that the Irredeemable state is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.description: Unlock condition undisclosed; hint: “Second time's the charm.”
trophies.guide: The notes provide only the quoted hint. Keep the requirement open until the game reveals more.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.description: Unlock condition undisclosed; hint: “What the hell just happened?”
trophies.guide: The supplied source gives a hint but no confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: The description suggests a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The cited description says “Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.” A precise method is not supplied.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through contacts.
trophies.guide: After obtaining the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3, collect marked bills from banks and Payday Loans and sell them to fences. Earnings are cumulative; Yasmani reportedly pays most.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Purchases add up across stores. Weapons, vehicle customization and tattoos are suggested ways to spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, purchase the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app. The four story garages do not count; the total is about $160,000.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Unlock the app through Moses's Chapter 2 mission and take vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage. Leave garage space free and register ten vehicles.
